lines.text: English starts with a big E!
Many learners say: I speak english every day.
Better: I speak English every day.
The name of a language starts big.
English! I study English at school.

data.why: The name of a language starts big.

native.hook: English 的 E 要大写！
native.tip: 汉字没有大小写，所以容易把 English 写成小写。语言名称的首字母要大写。
native.caption: 你是不是也会写 “I speak english every day.”😅 汉字没有大小写，英语里语言名称的首字母要大写：“I speak English every day.”跟着 Ama 老师写一写！在 Lexkite 应用里练习更多。
native.comment: 答案：“I speak English every day.”大声读一遍，再写一句你自己的句子。免费测验在这里：{link}

en.tip: The name of a language always starts with a capital letter.
en.caption: Do you write “I speak english every day.” 😅 The name of a language always starts with a capital letter: “I speak English every day.” Write it with Ama! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
